facts.fact: AIB reports that a team of three IT staff from the Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil, sent from Ouagadougou, trained the civil-status agents of Koloko town hall on VENEEM, which it calls the national solution for systematic declaration and registration of civil-status events; the session is undated, so the date is the document's.

Civil-status agents of the commune of Koloko (Kénédougou) received two days of training on the VENEEM software and were given equipment, per AIB; the session is undated, so the date is the document's.
